description:
A healthcare call center is launching a patient appointment reminder campaign. Create a new custom screen label configuration in Vicidial so agents see healthcare-specific field names instead of generic defaults.

Navigate to the Screen Labels section in the Vicidial admin panel (under Admin) and create a new screen label with the following settings:

- Label ID: HEALTH01
- Label Name: Healthcare Appointment Campaign
- Title Label: Patient Outreach
- First Name Label: Patient First Name
- Last Name Label: Patient Last Name
- Address1 Label: Patient Street Address
- Address2 Label: Suite or Unit
- Address3 Label: Insurance Provider
- City Label: Patient City
- State Label: Patient State
- Alt Phone Label: Pharmacy Phone
- Email Label: Patient Email
- Comments Label: Medical Notes

Save the configuration when complete. The Vicidial admin panel is at http://localhost/vicidial/admin.php (credentials: user 6666, password andromeda).
